in_sanskrit.name: Roza
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Rose
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Roza एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Roza is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Rasayana’, which means ‘a process that heals or rejuvenates’. The name also symbolizes the radiant beauty and grace of a rose flower. In Hinduism, the rose is considered a symbol of love, purity, and devotion.
